candidates.title: Perception Before Supervision: Self-Contained Visual Distillation from Counterfactual Blind Spots
candidates.summary: Self-improvement for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is typically driven by reward-based methods that provide only coarse scalar feedback. Distillation offers a richer alternative through dense token-level supervision, but in the visual domain it usually depends on privileged context constructed using external annotations and tools, or stronger models.
